target_concept: Explain why global user name and email are required and how to set them with git config

mcq.questionText: Which of the following command sequences correctly sets both the global Git user name to "Alice" and the global email to "alice@example.com"?
options: git config --global user.name "Alice" && git config --global user.email "alice@example.com"
mcq.correctAnswer: git config --global user.name "Alice" && git config --global user.email "alice@example.com"
mcq.explanation: The correct sequence uses the --global flag for both settings and includes both the user.name and user.email assignments. Option A only sets the name, option B only sets the email, and option D omits the required --global flag, so only option C satisfies the requirement.
